maps.name: Varnfell
maps.description: Varnfell is a cold country between Hollowmere's dark woods and empty harbor and the great mountains far to the East. This massive continental landscape is home to many lost civilizations that all thought they would live forever.

maps.name: Southwest Varnfell
maps.description: The southwestern corner of Varnfell: the healing shrine and graveyard on the coast, the Abandoned Tower, the Dark Wood, and the old village to the south.

maps.name: Hallowmere
maps.description: The first village on the old dragon's road, hundreds of years ago the king came from Varnfell's distant capital to raise an army of adventures to destroy the old dragon. The king, the villagers and the dragon disappeared from history. Hallowmere gradually lost touch with the kingdom and had to figure out how to defend it's people in a world that has grown bleaker and bleaker since the king vanished.

maps.name: Drago's Dive
maps.description: Drago's dive is a beaten up building smelling of old yeast and boiled meat. Yelling and loud banging can be heard as you approach the entrance.
